label: late copy phase (recalling original position 5+), token-gated
explanation: Fires mostly (~90% of mass) in the copy phase when the model is outputting original token 5 or later (recall_idx 5-8, rate ~20-32% vs <6% at recall_idx<=4), strongest near the end of the sequence (to_go 0-1 carries ~75% of mass). Only a minority of such steps fire: which ones depends on the input token (k, p, t, j, 1 most likely at ~15%, then u, 2, n); adding this token set raises precision to ~0.59 but drops mass recall to ~0.55. A secondary ~10% of mass is in the original phase at t=2 (third input token), and a little at t=3. Never fires at t=0,1, the delimiter, or recall_idx 0-1. Top activations are at the last or second-to-last copy step of long sequences (L=6-9).
